rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: Satchmo ®
Exhibition name: Satchmo ®
rows.Origin: Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1963).
rows.Bloom: Scarlet, . Red. Orange-red, Deep red. Petals blacken at edges. None to mild fragrance. 25 petals. Average diameter 3". Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters, classic hybrid tea, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, bushy, compact. Dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 4'11" (60 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.
rows.Breeder's notes: Satchmo - 63/1324. Nicknamed Powell. for Louis Armstrong.
